<script>
function toggleLang() {
  document.body.classList.toggle('cn');
  const btn = document.getElementById('lang-btn');
  btn.textContent = document.body.classList.contains('cn') ? 'EN' : '中文';
  localStorage.setItem('lang', document.body.classList.contains('cn') ? 'cn' : 'en');
}
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  if (localStorage.getItem('lang') === 'cn') {
    document.body.classList.add('cn');
    var btn = document.getElementById('lang-btn');
    if (btn) btn.textContent = 'EN';
  }
});

function openShinyApp() {
  var modal = document.getElementById('shiny-modal');
  modal.classList.add('active');
  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  var iframe = modal.querySelector('iframe');
  if (!iframe.src) iframe.src = 'https://guofang1028.shinyapps.io/ShinyApp/';
}
function closeShinyApp() {
  var modal = document.getElementById('shiny-modal');
  modal.classList.remove('active');
  document.body.style.overflow = '';
}
</script>

<h2 class="text-4xl md:text-5xl font-bold border-l-4 border-primary pl-8"><span class="lang-en">About This Project</span><span class="lang-cn">关于本项目</span></h2>
<div class="space-y-6 text-slate-400 leading-relaxed text-lg">
<p class="lang-en-block">COFINFAD Analytics is an interactive R Shiny application that transforms Colombia's fintech data into accessible, visual business intelligence. Built on a dataset of 48,723 customers and 3.16 million transactions, the app follows a three-stage analytical narrative: exploring transactional patterns through interactive EDA, segmenting customers via multi-method clustering, and predicting churn risk with regularized regression &mdash; all within a unified dashboard requiring no coding.</p>
<p class="lang-cn-block">COFINFAD Analytics 是一个交互式 R Shiny 应用程序，将哥伦比亚的金融科技数据转化为直观、可视化的商业智能。基于 48,723 名客户和 316 万笔交易数据，该应用遵循三阶段分析叙事：通过交互式 EDA 探索交易模式、通过多方法聚类细分客户群体、以及使用正则化回归预测客户流失风险——所有功能集成在统一仪表板中，无需编写代码。</p>
</div>

<h2 class="text-4xl font-bold mb-6 text-center"><span class="lang-en">Core Modules</span><span class="lang-cn">核心模块</span></h2>
<p class="text-slate-400 text-center max-w-3xl mx-auto mb-16 text-lg lang-en-block">Our analysis follows a coherent narrative: explore <strong class="text-white">what</strong> is happening (EDA), ask <strong class="text-white">why</strong> via customer segmentation (Clustering), and predict <strong class="text-white">what will happen</strong> (Churn Prediction).</p>
<p class="text-slate-400 text-center max-w-3xl mx-auto mb-16 text-lg lang-cn-block">我们的分析遵循连贯的叙事逻辑：通过 EDA 探索<strong class="text-white">正在发生什么</strong>，通过客户细分（聚类）探究<strong class="text-white">为什么</strong>，再通过流失预测判断<strong class="text-white">未来会怎样</strong>。</p>
<div class="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-10">
<!-- Card 1: Module 1 -->
<div class="bg-card-dark border border-border-dark p-10 rounded-2xl group hover:border-primary/50 transition-all">
<div class="w-16 h-16 bg-blue-500/10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center mb-8 group-hover:bg-blue-500 transition-colors">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-blue-400 group-hover:text-white text-3xl">query_stats</span>
</div>
<span class="text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-300 rounded border border-blue-500/20 mb-4 inline-block"><span class="lang-en">Module 1</span><span class="lang-cn">模块一</span></span>
<h3 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4"><span class="lang-en">Exploratory &amp; Confirmatory Data Analysis</span><span class="lang-cn">探索性与验证性数据分析</span></h3>
<p class="text-slate-400 mb-3 leading-relaxed lang-en-block">Interactive time-series of transaction volumes, ANOVA &amp; Welch's T-test with effect-size reporting, Leaflet choropleth maps of 15 Colombian departments, correlation heatmaps, and demographic distribution analysis.</p>
<p class="text-slate-400 mb-3 leading-relaxed lang-cn-block">交互式交易量时间序列、ANOVA 和 Welch T 检验（含效应量）、哥伦比亚 15 个省份的 Leaflet 分级统计地图、相关性热图和人口统计分布分析。</p>
<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-6">
<span class="text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-300 rounded border border-blue-500/20">ggplot2</span>
<span class="text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-300 rounded border border-blue-500/20">plotly</span>
<span class="text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-300 rounded border border-blue-500/20">leaflet</span>
<span class="text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-300 rounded border border-blue-500/20">sf</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Card 2: Module 2 -->
<div class="bg-card-dark border border-border-dark p-10 rounded-2xl group hover:border-primary/50 transition-all">
<div class="w-16 h-16 bg-purple-500/10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center mb-8 group-hover:bg-purple-500 transition-colors">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-purple-400 group-hover:text-white text-3xl">hub</span>
</div>
<span class="text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-300 rounded border border-purple-500/20 mb-4 inline-block"><span class="lang-en">Module 2</span><span class="lang-cn">模块二</span></span>
<h3 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4"><span class="lang-en">Customer Behavior Clustering</span><span class="lang-cn">客户行为聚类</span></h3>
<p class="text-slate-400 mb-3 leading-relaxed lang-en-block">Segment 48,723 customers using K-Means, Hierarchical (Ward's D2), and PAM with 10 behavioral features. PCA scatter plots, elbow &amp; silhouette diagnostics, and cluster profile radar charts.</p>
<p class="text-slate-400 mb-3 leading-relaxed lang-cn-block">使用 K-Means、层次聚类（Ward's D2）和 PAM 方法，基于 10 个行为特征对 48,723 名客户进行细分。包含 PCA 散点图、肘部法与轮廓系数诊断图、聚类画像雷达图。</p>
<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-6">
<span class="text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-300 rounded border border-purple-500/20">cluster</span>
<span class="text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-300 rounded border border-purple-500/20">factoextra</span>
<span class="text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-300 rounded border border-purple-500/20">viridis</span>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Card 3: Module 3 -->
<div class="bg-card-dark border border-border-dark p-10 rounded-2xl group hover:border-primary/50 transition-all">
<div class="w-16 h-16 bg-green-500/10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center mb-8 group-hover:bg-green-500 transition-colors">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-green-400 group-hover:text-white text-3xl">psychology</span>
</div>
<span class="text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-green-500/10 text-green-300 rounded border border-green-500/20 mb-4 inline-block"><span class="lang-en">Module 3</span><span class="lang-cn">模块三</span></span>
<h3 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4"><span class="lang-en">Churn Prediction &amp; What-If Simulation</span><span class="lang-cn">流失预测与假设模拟</span></h3>
<p class="text-slate-400 mb-3 leading-relaxed lang-en-block">Pre-trained Lasso (L1) &amp; Ridge (L2) via 10-fold CV. Interactive &lambda; slider for bias-variance tradeoff. What-If simulator adjusts customer attributes and shows predicted churn probability in real time.</p>
<p class="text-slate-400 mb-3 leading-relaxed lang-cn-block">通过 10 折交叉验证预训练 Lasso (L1) 和 Ridge (L2) 模型。交互式 &lambda; 滑块展示偏差-方差权衡。What-If 模拟器可调整客户属性，实时显示预测的流失概率。</p>
<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-6">
<span class="text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-green-500/10 text-green-300 rounded border border-green-500/20">glmnet</span>
<span class="text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-green-500/10 text-green-300 rounded border border-green-500/20">shiny</span>
<span class="text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-green-500/10 text-green-300 rounded border border-green-500/20">bslib</span>
<span class="text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-green-500/10 text-green-300 rounded border border-green-500/20">DT</span>
</div>
</div>

            Our R Shiny application brings all three modules together in a unified, interactive dashboard. Explore transaction trends, segment customers, and simulate churn scenarios &mdash; no coding required.
        </p>
<p class="text-slate-400 text-lg max-w-2xl mx-auto mb-10 lang-cn-block">
            我们的 R Shiny 应用将三个模块整合到统一的交互式仪表板中。探索交易趋势、细分客户群体、模拟流失场景——无需编写任何代码。
        </p>
<div class="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-6 mb-10">
